001package com.streamConverter;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.IStreamCommand;
004import com.streamConverter.command.impl.SampleStreamCommand;
005import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
006import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
007import java.io.IOException;
008import java.io.InputStream;
009import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
010import org.slf4j.Logger;
011import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
012
013/**
014 * Main class for the StreamConverter application.
015 *
016 * <p>This class demonstrates the usage of the StreamConverter with sample commands.
017 */
018public class Main {
019  private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(Main.class);
020
021  /**
022   * Main method to run the StreamConverter application.
023   *
024   * @param args Command line arguments (not used).
025   * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs during the execution.
026   */
027  public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
028    log.info("Starting StreamConverter application");
029    IStreamCommand[] commands = {
030      new SampleStreamCommand("0"), new SampleStreamCommand("1"), new SampleStreamCommand("2")
031    };
032    StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(commands);
033    try (InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream("any message".getBytes());
034        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
035      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
036      log.info("Processing result: {}", outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
037    } catch (IOException e) {
038      log.error("Application execution failed: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
039    }
040
041    log.info("StreamConverter application completed");
042  }
043}
